Creeps and Curses V.3.1

Special Trait. Please note that these abilities are incredibly powerful even for the JJK system and should only be used for purposely high power games. Of course, certain traits are stronger than others. Stages of these traits have been added to grow with characters with higher levels of play. Dormant, Stirring, and Awakened. Though a DM can decide to change the leveling format or instead give them out at appropriate character moments.

Extra Limbs. You can use the additional limbs and mouths on your body to make handsigns and chant to activate techniques faster than any normal sorcerer. The action cost of a technique is decreased by one level for you (Full Turn Action > Action > Bonus Action > Reaction > Free Action) and can ignore all limitations for Chanting. Additionally, when you take the Attack action on your turn, you can make two additional melee attacks as part of that attack action. You also have advantage on ability checks to grapple or resist being grappled.

War God’s Body. Your hit point maximum increases by 4 times your level and you gain an additional 4 hit points every time you gain a level (This replaces Powerful Body). Additionally, your Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution scores increase by 4 again and so does their maximum.

Natural Weapons. The damage of your unarmed strikes increases to 2d8.

Special Trait tiers stack: keep the earlier tiers on the sheet. When a benefit says it replaces an earlier one, the module's effects already account for it.

system.requirements: Must not be a Cursed Corpse; Perfect Form, level 14
